title: Selected fitted q upturn requires an explicit acceleration derivative test

source_evidence.locator: Sec.IV Fig.5; Table II; source Eq.(1)

assumptions: q=-a_ddot/(aH^2); z increases toward the past, dt/dz=-1/[(1+z)H].
Named best-fit feature occurs for BC+Union3 cubic-y/cubic-log without SH0ES and disappears in the corresponding plus-H0 curves.
No jerk posterior, derivative covariance or physical theory is supplied; weaker-than-fiducial q0 and time evolution of acceleration are distinct claims.
predictions: q<0 establishes acceleration conditionally on reconstructed kinematics; qdot>0 means decreasing dimensionless -q.
j=q+2q^2+(1+z)dq/dz governs a_dddot; decreasing a_ddot requires j<0, and decreasing a_ddot/a requires j+q<0.

Figure 5 alone establishes a conditional best-fit q-shape feature, not a calibrated detection of decreasing a_ddot or a future end of acceleration. BC+Union3 cubic-y q0=-0.09 +/-0.20 includes zero at 68% CL.
